title: A Research Protocol on Leap Motion Tracking Device: A Novel Intervention Method for Distal Radial Fracture Rehabilitation
protocol: Recruit subjects (N=40) by screening them with inclusion and exclusion criteria.
Obtain informed consent from the subjects.
Record medical history of the subjects.
Perform a baseline assessment on all recruited subjects.
Allocate 20 subjects to the experimental group and 20 subjects to the control group.
Conduct a 6-week intervention for the experimental group, including Leap motion control rehabilitation for 30 min/day and conventional rehabilitation for 30 min/day.
Conduct a 6-week intervention for the control group with conventional rehabilitation for 60 min/day.
Perform a post-treatment assessment on all subjects after the interventions.
